about_the_game:
Fengshen Siege — Transport yourself to the ancient and mysterious world of the Investiture of the Gods, embarking on a thrilling side-scrolling combat adventure.

Based on the classic novel Investiture of the Gods, the game immerses you at the heart of the divine war, witnessing iconic battles unfold firsthand.

Innovative 2D Visual Presentation: Side-view characters + top-down combat deliver a fresh and visually striking experience.

Cold-Weapon Combat Showcases Martial Arts Essence: Traditional cold-weapon combat sequences are spectacular. Control your character to execute slashes, thrusts, blocks, spinning strikes, and more. Unleash devastating skills like killing intent shockwaves to dominate the battlefield.

Divine Artifacts Emerge to Command the Battlefield:

Artifacts are a hallmark of Fengshen Yanyi, and the game faithfully incorporates them: the Heavenly Rings, Divine-Slaying Whip, Xinghuang Banner, Fan Tian Seal, Hun Yuan Golden Cauldron, Golden Dragon Shears, Howling Heaven Dog, Flowered Sable, Qingyun Sword, Hun Yuan Pearl Umbrella, Moye Sword, Immortal-Binding Rope, Dragon-Escape Pillar, Yin-Yang Mirror, Heaven-Opening Pearl... Each possesses unique abilities.

Spell Duels: Unleash Divine Powers: Players can experience the novel's breathtaking magical combat. Transform into Nezha with three heads and eight arms to surge your combat power instantly. Master earth-walking and earth-diving techniques to move freely across battlefields. Spells like “Name-Calling Knockdown,” “Hum-Ha Dual Breath,” and “Red Pearl Breath” let you feel the wonder and might of immortal duels.

All Factions Assembled: The game encompasses nearly every major character from both factions in Investiture of the Gods. Whether righteous immortals of the Xiantiao Sect or enigmatic masters of the Jie Sect, they may all serve under your command. Each character possesses unique magical artifacts and skills. Strategically assemble your ultimate Investiture of the Gods squad.

Personalized Mounts: Jiang Ziya's Quadruped, Huang Feihu's Five-Colored Divine Ox, Zhao Gongming's Black Tiger, Lü Yue's Golden-Eyed Camel, the Three Xiao Sisters' Divine Bird, the Four Saints of Jiulong Island's Fierce Beast, Luo Xuan's Flame Steed, Nezha's Wind-Fire Wheels... These mounts not only boast dazzling appearances but also grant characters additional attribute bonuses, giving you an edge in battle.

Deeply Authentic, Where Details Reveal True Craftsmanship: The Investiture of the Gods Simulator is dedicated to faithfully recreating every thrilling detail of the novel's divine battles. Jiang Ziya's Divine-Slaying Whip can interrupt Grand Marshal Wen's Yin-Yang Whip; Yang Jian can instantly kill the Flowered Fox with his innate divine power; Nezha's Heaven-Earth Ring can shatter jade artifacts; ordinary generals' horses will bolt in terror upon encountering the Four Saints of Nine Dragons Island's monstrous mounts; Fire-Receiving Heavenly Lord Liu Huan can amplify Luo Xuan's fire-based attacks; Princess Longji's Four Seas Vase counters Fire God Luo Xuan's fire artifacts, nullifying their flames; Princess Longji's Outer Banner Gate counters Hong Jin's Inner Banner Gate... These rich and intricate mechanics make battles more authentic and engaging, while also testing players' knowledge of the Investiture lore and strategic combat prowess.

Character Growth: Every Playthrough is a Fresh Experience: During combat, characters gradually level up and randomly enhance various abilities. This means each game session cultivates a hero with a completely distinct growth path. This random growth mechanic adds immense replayability and depth, filling every battle with unpredictability and surprises.

Fengshen Siege, an indie game blending unique art style, meticulous design, and rich content, awaits your courageous exploration. Join now and embark on this one-of-a-kind Fengshen adventure!
